import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.claude/state/session-signals/cost-tracking.jsonl')
models=Counter(); providers=Counter(); missing_cost=0; missing_wrk=0
for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    d=json.loads(line)
    models[d.get('model','')] += 1
    providers[d.get('provider','')] += 1
    if 'cost_usd' not in d or d.get('cost_usd') in (None, ''):
        missing_cost += 1
    if 'wrk' not in d or d.get('wrk') in (None, ''):
        missing_wrk += 1
print('providers', providers)
print('models', models.most_common(10))
print('missing_cost', missing_cost)
print('missing_wrk', missing_wrk)
PY
